parameters.html:
=

Thank you, {{ $json.body.acceptance.name }}.

This email is your confirmation. The check-in pass below is what our team will scan when you arrive — keep this email on your phone, or save the image and bring it with you.

{{ $json.body.acceptance.photoConsent === 'in' ? '📷 You agreed to event photography' : '🚫 You opted out of event photography' }}
{{ $json.body.acceptance.photoConsent === 'in' ? 'We may include you in photographs taken at the event.' : 'Our team will respect your preference and avoid photographing you.' }}

What you accepted

  • Terms & Conditions — updated {{ $json.body.acceptance.terms.lastUpdated }}
  • Privacy Policy — updated {{ $json.body.acceptance.privacy.lastUpdated }}
  • Signed on {{ $json.body.acceptance.signedAt ? DateTime.fromISO($json.body.acceptance.signedAt).toLocaleString(DateTime.DATETIME_MED) : '' }}

Your signature

If anything looks wrong — your name, email, or photography preference — please reply to this email, or sign in again at tos.undefined.charity.

With thanks,
The Undefined team

Undefined Charity · contact@undefined.charity

parameters.subject: =You’re checked in, {{ $json.body.acceptance.name }} — welcome to the Undefined event
parameters.html:
=

Welcome, {{ $json.body.acceptance.name }}.

You’re checked in. Thank you for joining us at the Undefined event — we’re glad to have you here.

{{ $json.body.acceptance.photoConsent === 'out' ? '

Please see a member of staff to collect your wristband.

' : '' }}
{{ $json.body.acceptance.photoConsent === 'in' ? '📷 You agreed to event photography' : '🚫 You opted out of event photography' }}
{{ $json.body.acceptance.photoConsent === 'in' ? 'Our team may include you in photographs taken at the event.' : 'Our team has been notified of your preference and will not photograph you.' }}

Your check-in details

  • Checked in at {{ $json.body.scannedAt ? DateTime.fromISO($json.body.scannedAt).toLocaleString(DateTime.DATETIME_MED) : 'now' }}
  • Originally signed on {{ $json.body.acceptance.signedAt ? DateTime.fromISO($json.body.acceptance.signedAt).toLocaleString(DateTime.DATETIME_MED) : '' }}
  • Terms & Conditions — updated {{ $json.body.acceptance.terms.lastUpdated }}
  • Privacy Policy — updated {{ $json.body.acceptance.privacy.lastUpdated }}
{{ $json.body.policyCurrent === false ? '

Note: our policies have been updated since you last signed. Please take a moment to sign again at tos.undefined.charity at your convenience.

' : '' }}

If you didn’t just check in, please let a member of staff know so we can sort it out. If you’d like to change your photography preference at any time, sign in again at tos.undefined.charity.

Enjoy the event,
The Undefined team

Undefined Charity · contact@undefined.charity
